description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract class 'ModelScreenWidget' used in the OFBiz framework to model various types of screen widgets and their rendering behavior. It includes nested classes representing different widget types such as sections, containers, labels, forms, and more, each with specific rendering logic and properties.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget
classes.description: Abstract base class for all widget models, providing rendering methods and nested subclasses for specific widget types.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.SectionsRenderer
classes.description: Manages rendering of multiple sections, buffering output and facilitating section rendering by name.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.Section
classes.description: Represents a section within a screen, capable of conditional rendering and handling sub-widgets, actions, and fail-widgets.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.ColumnContainer
classes.description: Represents a container with columns, expandable IDs and styles, containing multiple Column objects.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.Column
classes.description: A single column in a container, with expandable ID and style, containing sub-widgets.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.Container
classes.description: A container widget that can have ID, type, style, auto-update properties, and sub-widgets.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.Screenlet
classes.description: A widget representing a screenlet, which includes optional navigation menus, forms, and collapsible behavior.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.HorizontalSeparator
classes.description: A widget for rendering a horizontal separator with optional style and ID.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.IncludeScreen
classes.description: Embeds another screen specified by name and location, with optional share scope.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.DecoratorScreen
classes.description: Wraps content with decorator sections, managing scope and rendering referenced screens.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.DecoratorSection
classes.description: A section within a decorator screen, rendering sub-widgets.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.DecoratorSectionInclude
classes.description: Includes a section from a decorator, rendering pre-rendered content or sections.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.Label
classes.description: Represents a text label with optional styling and ID, capable of encoding text.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.Form
classes.description: Includes a form specified by name and location, with scope sharing options; manages form rendering.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.Grid
classes.description: Includes a grid by name and location, supporting scope sharing and grid rendering.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.Content
classes.description: Displays content identified by content ID, supporting editing and escape options.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.PlatformSpecific
classes.description: Manages platform-specific sub-widgets for different rendering types such as HTML, XSL-FO, XML, etc.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget.Tree
classes.description: Includes a tree widget for hierarchical data, with scope sharing.

methods.name: renderWidgetString
methods.description: Abstract method to render widget as string, implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: readSubWidgets
methods.description: Reads sub-widgets from XML elements into a list of ModelScreenWidget.

methods.name: renderSubWidgetsString
methods.description: Renders a list of sub-widgets to output, with context and renderer.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the widget, either from context or fixed attribute.

methods.name: shareScope
methods.description: Checks if the widget scope should be shared across screen inclusions.

methods.name: getContentId
methods.description: Returns the content ID associated with the content widget.
